assets.name: ledger-room
assets.prompt: Interior of a warm medieval European home at night, seen from a seated viewpoint. A rustic dark-wood desk in the lower foreground, a stone hearth with glowing embers to one side, heavy timber beams overhead, a small leaded window showing a cold blue winter night, dried herbs and a copper pot hanging in the background. The room is cozy, lived-in and calm. Leave the centre of the frame deliberately uncluttered and softly out of focus so text can be laid over it. Shallow depth of field, cinematic warm lighting.

assets.name: ledger-paper
assets.prompt: Top-down flat scan of one large sheet of aged parchment paper used as a merchant ledger page. The sheet is completely blank. Even soft lighting, no hard shadows, generous empty space across the middle. Looks like real antique paper under warm lamplight.
